blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing product matching benchmarks primarily contain English-language product data and are often dominated by a single product category, such as electronics. This paper introduces Billiger.de Products, a bilingual German and English entity matching benchmark covering thirteen consumer product categories, including difficult-to-handle categories such as clothing and furniture. The benchmark data originates from the German price comparison platform billiger.de. Following the design of WDC Products, the benchmark offers multiple variants that differ in the fraction of corner cases, the size of the development set, and the fraction of entities unseen during training. An aligned English translation of every offer keeps all pairs, splits, and labels fixed, while cross-language test sets combine German and English records within individual pairs. We validate the benchmark using six supervised matchers and zero-shot GPT-5.2 on both language versions and the cross-language test sets. The validation shows the difficulty of the benchmark. The comparison of the results on the English version of the benchmark to the results on the German version shows that most matchers score on average higher on the English version. The difference is largest for RoBERTa and HierGAT, while the zero-shot LLM runs are largely insensitive to the language. Comparing the F1 scores achieved by PLM-based matchers on the English version of Billiger.de Products with their performance on existing English-language benchmarks, such as WDC Products and Abt-Buy, shows that Billiger.de Products is more difficult than these benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 现有的产品匹配基准主要包含英语产品数据,并经常以电子等单一产品类别为主. 本文介绍Billiger.de Products,是德语和英语双语实体匹配基准,涵盖13个消费产品类别,包括服装和家具等难以处理的类别. 基准数据来源于德国价格比较平台billiger.de. 在WDC产品设计之后,该基准提供了多个变体,在角箱的分量,开发集的大小,以及培训期间所未见的实体的分量等方面都有差异. 每个报价的对齐英文译文保留所有对数,分数,和标签的固定,而跨语言测试集则将德语和英语记录结合在单个对数之内. 我们用6个受监督的匹配器和零镜头的GPT-5.2来验证基准,这两个语言版本和跨语言测试集. 验证显示基准难度. 将英语版基准结果与德语版基准结果的比较表明,大多数匹配者在英语版平均得分较高. RoBERTa和HierGAT的区别最大,而零镜头LLM运行对语言基本不敏感. 比较基于PLM的配对者在英语版Billiger上取得的F1分数. 以现有英语基准(如WDC产品和Abt-Buy)为依据的产品表明Billiger。 d 产品比这些基准更难。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Entity matching is the task of discovering records that refer to the same real-world entity in a single or across multiple data sources [ 5 , 4 ] . In e-commerce, the task appears at scale on price comparison platforms such as idealo.de, geizhals.de, or billiger.de, which continuously aggregate millions of product offers from thousands of shops and need to group offers that refer to the same product. Offers for the same product differ in naming conventions, attribute availability, attribute formatting, and description style. A shoe listed by one vendor as “Nike Air Force 1 ’07 – White – EU 42.5” may appear on another platform as “Nike AF1 Low ’07 Sneaker – Triple White – US 9”.
blocks.zh: 实体匹配是发现在一个单一或跨多个数据源中提及同一个现实世界实体的记录[5,4]的任务. 在电子商务中,任务的规模出现在价格比较平台上,如idealo.de、geizhals.de或billiger.de,这些平台不断汇总上千家商店提供的数百万个产品,需要将提及同一产品的报价分组。 对同一产品的报价在命名惯例、属性可用性、属性格式化和描述风格方面各不相同。 一个销售商列为“尼克空军一号07年—白色—欧盟42.5”的鞋子可能出现在另一个平台上,称为“尼克航空一号07年低空—三号白色—美国9号”。

blocks.en: Widely used entity matching benchmarks such as Abt-Buy, Amazon-Google, DBLP-Scholar, and Walmart-Amazon [ 15 , 21 , 28 ] provide a single level of task difficulty and contain almost exclusively English-language records. The WDC Products benchmark [ 26 ] addressed the difficulty limitation through independently controllable variation along three dimensions: the amount of corner cases, the fraction of entities unseen during training, and the development set size. However, WDC Products also consists of English data and is dominated by consumer electronics. The matching systems evaluated in recent studies build on language models pre-trained predominantly on English text [ 16 , 24 , 36 ] . How well such systems perform on non-English product data across a wide range of product categories is largely unknown. Existing benchmarks also do not cover the cross-language setting, in which product offers in different languages need to be matched, e.g. on a price comparison platform that aggregates offers across countries.
blocks.zh: 广泛使用的实体匹配基准,如Abt-Buy,Amazon-Google,DBLP-Scholar,以及Walmart-Amazon[15,21,28],提供了单级的任务难度,并包含几乎完全的英语记录. WDC产品基准[26]从三个方面通过可独立控制的变异解决了困难限制问题:转角案例的数量、培训期间未见的实体的一小部分以及开发设定的规模。 不过,WDC 产品还包括英语数据,以消费电子产品为主. 在最近的研究中评价的匹配系统建立在语言模型的基础上,这些模型主要是在英文文本上预先培训的[16、24、36]。 这种系统在各种产品类别的非英语产品数据上的表现如何,基本上不得而知。 现有基准也不涵盖各种语文的设定,在这种设定中,不同语文的产品需要匹配,例如,在各国提供的总价比较平台上。

blocks.en:
This paper presents Billiger.de Products, an entity matching benchmark in German, the language of one of the largest e-commerce markets in Europe [ 18 , 32 ] . It is constructed from product offers provided by solute GmbH, the operator of the price comparison platform billiger.de.
Following WDC Products, it provides three development set sizes (small, medium, large), three corner-case ratios (20 %, 50 %, 80 %), and three proportions of unseen entities (0 %, 50 %, 100 %), yielding 27 variants (Section 2.2 ). Its thirteen product categories include clothing and furniture, which are harder to handle for every evaluated matcher than electronics.
blocks.zh:
本文介绍 Billiger.de 产品,一个实体匹配的德语基准,是欧洲最大的电子商务市场之一的语言[18,32]. 它由价格比较平台Billiger.de的运营商Solute GmbH提供的产品报价建造。
追随WDC 产品,它提供三种开发设定大小(中小、大),三种角箱比率(20%、50%、80%),以及三种未见实体比例(0%、50%、100%),产生27种变体(第2.2节)。 它的13个产品类别包括衣物和家具,它们比电子产品更难处理每个被评价的匹配者.

blocks.en: The English version contains GPT-5-mini translations of the name and description attribute values of every offer, with all pairs, splits, and labels kept fixed. Comparing the two versions measures language effects together with the translation, and pairing German records with English translations of their counterparts enables cross-language evaluation. We validate both versions using six supervised matchers and zero-shot GPT-5.2 with two prompt designs, and additionally evaluate XLM-R, a multilingual pretrained language model, on the 80 % corner-case variants and in the cross-language setting. The contributions are:

blocks.en: 1. An entity matching benchmark for German-language consumer product data, containing 13,568 offers that describe 2,168 products from 13 categories, with fixed splits along the three dimensions: amount of corner cases, fraction of entities unseen during training, and the development set size. 2. An English translation of the complete benchmark that keeps all pairs, splits, and labels fixed, allowing direct comparability between entity matching in English and German as well as the construction of cross-language test sets. 3. Validation results for six supervised matchers and zero-shot GPT-5.2 on all 27 variants of both language versions and on the cross-language test sets. The results show the difficulty of the benchmark in both languages. Under German-only training, four of the five evaluated PLM-based matchers lose performance on cross-language pairs compared to same-language pairs, while GPT-5.2 shows no consistent cross-language penalty.

blocks.en: 2 Benchmark Creation
blocks.zh: 2 基准设定

blocks.en: This section describes benchmark construction from billiger.de product data, following WDC Products [ 26 ] with controlled corner-case ratios, unseen-entity ratios, and development set sizes.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍比勒格基准建设. d 产品数据,遵循WDC产品[26],有控制角/箱比率、无形实体比率和开发设定尺寸。

blocks.en: 2.1 Source Data
blocks.zh: 2.1 来源数据

blocks.en:
The raw data was provided by solute GmbH, the operator of the German price comparison platform billiger.de.
Each offer carries the textual attributes name , description , and brand , the numerical attribute price in Euro, and identifying attributes such as EAN/GTIN and manufacturer part numbers (MPN) with varying coverage. The product assignments supplied by solute determine which offers refer to the same product. The matchers receive only name, description, brand, and price. The EAN/GTIN and MPN attributes are excluded, whereas identifiers inside names or descriptions remain, as the MPN in Figure 1 shows. This reflects matching tasks in which no separate identifier attributes are available.
blocks.zh:
原始数据由德国价格比较平台billiger.de的运营商Solute GmbH提供.
每项报价都带有文字属性名称、说明和品牌、以欧元计的数字属性价格,并标明涵盖范围不同的属性,如EAN/GTIN和制造商部分编号。 由溶液提供的产品分配决定哪些报价指同一种产品。 匹配者只获得姓名、描述、品牌和价格。 如图1所示,EAN/GTIN和MPN属性不在此列,而名称或描述中的识别特征则依然存在。 这反映了没有单独标识属性的匹配任务.

blocks.en: Two preprocessing steps were applied to the source data: duplicate offers, caused for example by price updates of the same offer, were removed, as were offers whose names contain fewer than five words, as these are too sparsely described for meaningful matching. The remaining German-language offers cover the whole product range of a general-purpose price comparison portal (see Section 2.5 ).
blocks.zh: 对源数据采用了两个预处理步骤:由于同一报价的价格更新等原因导致的重复报价被删除,其名称少于五个字的报价也被删除,因为这些报价被描述得太少,难以进行有意义的匹配。 其余的德语报价涵盖一个通用价格比较门户的整个产品范围(见第2.5节)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Creation Process
blocks.zh: 2.2 创建过程

blocks.en: The benchmark realizes the same three dimensions as WDC Products [ 26 ] : (i) the amount of corner cases, (ii) the fraction of unseen entities in the test set, and (iii) the development set size, meaning the combined size of the training and the validation split. Varying these dimensions supports systematic comparisons of matching performance. Corner cases are positives and negatives close to the decision boundary of the two classes. Figure 1 shows an example for a positive and a negative corner-case pair. A positive corner case is a pair of matching offers whose surface forms are dissimilar, for example two offers for the same sneaker that describe the color using different vocabulary (Figure 1 , top). A negative corner case is a pair of non-matching offers whose textual representations are highly similar, for example offers for two variants of the same wardrobe that agree in brand, model name, and nearly the entire description and differ only in some or a single attribute (Figure 1 , bottom). The corner-case ratio of a benchmark variant controls which share of its products contributes such pairs, and thus how hard the variant is. An unseen entity is an entity, or product in this case, that appears in the test set but not in the training set, i.e. a trained matcher cannot directly memorize what separates this product from other similar products and instead needs to generalize to new products, analogous to the real world where new products are introduced daily.
blocks.zh: 基准实现与WDC产品相同的三个维度: (一)角箱量, (二)测试集中未见实体的分量, (三)开发集大小,是指培训与验证分量的组合大小. 这些维度的不同支持了对匹配性能的系统比较. 转角病例为正负数,接近两类决定边界. 图1显示正角对和负角对的示例。 一个正角案例是一对相匹配的报价,其表面形式不同,例如,对使用不同词汇描述颜色的同一运动鞋的两个报价(图1,顶部). 一个负角案例是一对不匹配的报价,其文字表述高度相似,例如,对相同衣柜中两个不同版本的报价,在品牌,模型名称上一致,几乎是整个描述,仅在一些或单一属性上不同(图1,下方). 基准变体的角/角比控制其产品中哪些份额有助于这种配对,因此变体有多难。 一个看不见的实体是一个实体,或在此情况下出现在测试集中而不是在培训集中的产品,即训练有素的匹配者无法直接记住将这种产品与其他类似产品区分开来的内容,而是需要概括到新产品,类似于每天引进新产品的现实世界.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Two corner-case pairs in the English version. Top: matching offers for the same sneaker with a differently spelled model name and an abbreviated versus a written-out colorway. Bottom: non-matching offers for two wardrobe variants that differ only in width and interior configuration. Bold marks the decisive evidence, descriptions are truncated.
blocks.zh: 图1:英文版的两对角箱。 Top:将同一运动鞋的报价与拼写不同的型号名称和缩写对写出色道匹配. 底部:两种服装不同,但宽度和内部配置不尽相同。 粗体标记了决定性的证据,描述被截断.

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes the four construction steps: (i) grouping similar products, (ii) selecting products, (iii) splitting offers, and (iv) generating pairs.
blocks.zh: 图2概括了四个建设步骤:(一)类似产品的分组,(二)选择产品,(三)分割报价,(四)生成对子.

blocks.en: The first step groups similar products to restrict the search for corner cases. The second selects 500 products for each corner-case ratio, combining similar but distinct products with randomly selected products. Disjoint product pools supply unseen evaluation products.
blocks.zh: 第一步将类似的产品分组,以限制寻找角落案例. 第二种选择为每个角箱比例选择500个产品,将类似但截然不同的产品与随机选择的产品相结合. 脱节的产品集合供应未见评价产品。

blocks.en: The third step splits offers into training, validation, and test sets. The proportion of products absent from training controls the unseen dimension, while the number of retained training offers controls development set size. The fourth step generates matching and non-matching pairs within these splits. Combining the three dimensions yields 27 variants.
blocks.zh: 第三步将提供分为培训、鉴定和测试组。 未能参加培训的产品比例控制着看不见的层面,而保留的培训数量则控制着开发设定的规模。 第四步在这些分裂中生成匹配配对和非匹配配对. 结合三个维度产生27种变体.

blocks.en: After these four steps, the names and descriptions of all selected offers are translated into English while preserving the pairs, splits, and labels. This produces an aligned English counterpart for every German benchmark variant, as described in Section 2.3 .
blocks.zh: 在这四个步骤之后,所有选定要约的名称和描述在保留对称,拆分和标签的同时被翻译成英文. 如第2.3节所述,这为每一德国基准变式提供了一致的英文对应版本。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Construction pipeline of the benchmark, from clustering to the aligned German and English releases.
blocks.zh: 图2:基准的建设管道,从集群到对齐的德文和英文版。

blocks.en: The cleansed corpus is first organized into coarse clusters of similar products using DBSCAN [ 11 ] on the product name attribute. This restricts the subsequent search for similar products to smaller candidate sets. 2 2 2 Clustering code and parameters: https://github.com/wbsg-uni-mannheim/billiger-de-products/blob/main/docs/benchmark-construction.md . Products with 7 to 80 offers form the pool for the seen products, as enough offers are needed for training, validation, and testing. Products with 4 to 6 offers form the pool for the unseen products, which contribute offers only to the evaluation splits, so seen and unseen products differ in offer count as well as in training exposure.
blocks.zh: 净化器首先用DBSCAN[11]在产品名称属性上组织成类似产品的粗团. 这使得随后对类似产品的搜索仅限于较小的候选套件. 2 2 集群代码和参数:https://github.com/wbsg-uni-mannheim/billiger-de-products/blob/main/docs/benchmark-building.md. 有7至80种产品为可见到产品提供储备,因为培训、鉴定和测试需要足够的供应。 有4至6种产品成为无形产品的集合体,这些产品只有助于评价的分割,因此所见和未见产品在报价计算和培训风险方面各不相同。

blocks.en: Each corner-case group contains five similar but distinct products selected from one DBSCAN cluster. One randomly chosen product serves as the anchor of the group. Four distinct products similar to the anchor are then added one by one. For each selection, the remaining candidates are ranked using one of four similarity metrics on the product name attribute: cosine, generalized Jaccard, Dice, or fastText embedding similarity. The metric is drawn at random for each selection so that no single metric dominates the process. The result is a group of five similar but distinct products, for example five wardrobes of the same model line in different widths. Offers belonging to these five products are used to construct corner-case pairs.
blocks.zh: 每个角箱组包含从一个DBSCAN集群中选取的5个类似但不同的产品. 一个随机选择的产品充当了集团的锚. 四个与锚类似的独特产品然后逐个添加. 对于每次选拔,其余的考生在产品名称属性上使用四个相似度度度量之一进行排名:余弦,泛性Jaccard,Dice,或快速Text嵌入相似度. 每个选择都随机抽取度量衡,因此没有单一度量衡主宰了这一过程. 结果是五套类似但又不同的产品,例如五套不同宽度的相同型号线的衣橱. 属于这五种产品的报价用于构建角箱对.

blocks.en: The three corner-case ratios combine corner-case products with random filler products drawn from the same candidate clusters. The 80 % set combines 400 corner-case products with 100 filler products, the 50 % set combines 250 with 250, and the 20 % set combines 100 with 400, so every set contains 500 products. The smaller corner-case selections are subsets of the larger ones, resulting in each set sharing part of their corner-case population. All development set sizes of one corner-case set contain the same 500 products and differ only in the number of offers retained per product.
blocks.zh: 三个角箱比率将角箱产品与来自同一候选组群的随机填充产品结合起来。 80%的套装将400个角箱产品和100个填料产品结合起来,50%的套装将250个填料产品和250个填料产品结合起来,20%的套装将100个填料产品和400个填料产品结合起来,因此每套装有500个产品. 较小的角箱选择是较大的子集,导致每组共享其角箱人口的一部分. 一套角装套装的所有开发设定大小都包含同样的500种产品,并且仅在每个产品保留报价的数量上有所不同.

blocks.en: This step controls the splitting of the selected product offers into training, validation and test sets. For seen products, the offers are split into training, validation, and test sets, retaining at most 15 offers per product. Each offer is assigned to exactly one split of a configuration, so no offer and no pair occurs in more than one split. For each selected product, two offers go to test, two to validation, and the rest to training. The development set size dimension retains two (small), three (medium), or up to eleven (large) offers per product in the training split, with the smaller sets being subsets of the larger ones.
blocks.zh: 这一步骤控制将选定的产品分成培训、验证和测试组。 就可见到的产品而言,它们分为培训、鉴定和测试组,每个产品最多保留15个。 每个要约被分配到一个配置的完全一个拆分上,所以在一个以上的拆分中没有要约和对. 每个选定的产品,有2个要试,2个要试,其余要试。 开发设定尺寸方面保留了两个(小),三个(中),或每个产品在培训中最多有11个(大),较小的一组是较大的一组。

blocks.en: The unseen dimension is realized by replacing 0 %, 50 %, or 100 % of the products in the test split with products from an unseen pool of 500 additional products, selected by the same procedure and the same corner-case ratio. A third pool, constructed identically, provides the unseen products for the validation sets which are created in the same way as the unseen test sets. Following WDC Products, we call the 0 %, 50 %, and 100 % unseen conditions Seen , Half-Seen , and Unseen , respectively.
blocks.zh: 通过将试验中的0%、50%或100%的产品与500种新产品组成的一个看不见的库中的产品分开,通过相同的程序和相同的角落-情况比例,实现看不见的维度。 第三个池的构造完全相同,为验证组提供看不见的产品,这些验证组的创建方式与看不见的测试组相同。 根据WDC产品,我们分别将0%、50%和100%的隐形条件称为“见、半见和不明”。

blocks.en: The final step turns the selected offers into labelled record pairs. Two offers are labelled as a match if they share the same product assignment supplied by solute. Positive pairs are generated exhaustively from such offers in each training, validation and test split. Additionally, for each offer, high similarity negative pairs are selected among the remaining 499 products using the same metrics as before, one pair in the small, two in the medium, and three in the large configuration, plus one additional random negative pair. After these steps, the benchmark comprises nine training sets (3 corner-case ratios × \times 3 sizes), nine validation configurations in three sizes, and nine test sets (3 corner-case ratios × \times 3 unseen proportions), yielding overall 27 benchmark variants.
blocks.zh: 最后一步将选定的要约变为有标签的记录对. 两个报价如果共用溶液提供的相同产品,则标注为匹配。 在每次培训、验证和测试分期进行中,都通过提供这种机会,详尽地生成正对。 此外,对于每项报价,在使用与前作相同的度量衡的其余499种产品中选择了高度相似性负对,在小产品中选择1对,在中产品中选择2对,在大产品配置中选择3对,外加1对额外的随机负对. 在这些步骤之后,基准包括9个培训组(3个角-案件比率×x\times 3个大小),9个验证组合,3个大小;9个测试组(3个角-案件比率×\times 3个不为人知的比例),得出总体27个基准变量。

blocks.en: 2.3 English Version of the Benchmark
blocks.zh: 2.3 基准英文本

blocks.en: The English version of the benchmark contains translations of the attributes name and description of every record from German to English. All identifiers, product assignments, splits, labels, and the attributes brand and price stay unchanged. Each unique offer was translated with the GPT-5-mini model (snapshot gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 ), instructed to return JSON mirroring the record structure. Outputs violating the format were corrected manually. As a result, every offer in the benchmark exists in an aligned German and English version and every German benchmark variant has an identical English counterpart. Furthermore, German and English records can be combined into cross-language pairs for the experiments in Section 5 . The translation also keeps locale conventions unchanged, so prices stay in Euro and measurements in the metric system.
blocks.zh: 基准的英文版包含每个记录从德文到英文的属性名称和描述的翻译. 所有标识,产品任务,拆分,标签,属性品牌和价格不变. 每个独特的报价都用GPT-5-mini模型(snapshot gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07)翻译,指示返回JSON镜像记录结构. 违反格式的产出经过人工更正。 因此,基准中的每一个报价都以一致的德文和英文版本存在,每个德国基准变量都有相同的英文对应版本. 此外,德文记录和英文记录可合并成跨语种对,用于第5节中的实验。 翻译中还保持了地方惯例不变,因此价格以欧元为单位,测量以公制为单位.

blocks.en: The translation was validated in two steps. Automated equality checks confirmed that identifiers, counts, and dataset dimensions equal the German version. For the content, three LLMs of different families, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and GLM 5.3 Flash, compared the German and English versions of 3,000 randomly sampled test offers with the same prompt, checking identifiers, variant attributes, quantities, and omissions. An error counts as matching-relevant if it could change a match decision, for example a changed model number, size, material, or package quantity. One author then reviewed, blind to the model judgments, all 75 offers that at least one model flagged as matching-relevant, 100 offers that all models judged error-free, and 50 further offers, and found 11, zero, and one matching-relevant errors, respectively. Weighting these rates by stratum size yields an estimated 0.68 % matching-relevant translation errors. The matchers in Section 4.2 achieve similar performance when trained on either language version further supporting that the translation has not negatively impacted the matching signals.
blocks.zh: 译文分两步验证. 自动平等检查证实,识别、计数和数据集维度与德语版相等。 关于内容,不同家庭的三个LLMs,DeepSeek V4 Flash,双子座3.8 Flash和GLM 5.3 Flash),将3000个随机抽样测试报价的德文版和英文版与相同的即时,检查识别符,变体属性,数量,以及省略. 如果一个错误可以改变匹配决定,例如改变模型编号、大小、材料或包数量,则该错误算作匹配相关。 之后,一名作者对示范判决视而不见,所有75人提出至少一个标注为匹配相关的模型,100人提出所有模型评断无错误,50人提出进一步报价,分别发现11、0和1个匹配相关的错误。 按层大小加权这些比率估计会产生0.68%的匹配相关翻译错误。 第4.2节中的匹配者在接受任一语言版本的培训后,都取得了类似的业绩,进一步证明翻译没有给匹配信号带来负面影响。

blocks.en: 2.4 Benchmark Statistics
blocks.zh: 2.4 基准统计

blocks.en: Both language versions of the benchmark contain overall 13,568 product offers describing 2,168 products. Table 1 reports the pair composition of the training, validation, and test splits. The validation columns show the Seen validation sets used for model selection, whose products all occur in the corresponding training sets. The test sets exhibit a class imbalance of roughly 1:10 to 1:13. To assess label quality, one author re-annotated a stratified random sample of 100 unique test pairs, comprising 50 matches and 50 non-matches, blind to the released labels. The re-annotation agreed with all 50 match labels and 49 of the 50 non-match labels. Weighting these class-specific disagreement rates by the 1:11.8 class imbalance of the unique test pairs yields an estimated disagreement rate of 1.8 %.
blocks.zh: 基准的两种语文版本都包含总共13 568个产品报价,说明2 168个产品。 表1汇报了培训、鉴定和测试的配对组成。 验证栏显示用于模型选择的Seen验证集,其产品全部出现在相应的训练集中. 测试组显示的班级不平衡约为1:10至1:13. 为了评估标签质量,一位作者对100对独特的测试对的分层随机抽样重新作了说明,包括50个匹配和50个非匹配,对所发布的标签视而不见. 重新注释同意所有50个匹配标签和50个非匹配标签中的49个. 以1:11.8的等级失衡来权衡这些特定等级的分歧率,这些独特测试对的结果估计产生1.8%的分歧率.

blocks.en: Table 1: Pair composition per corner-case ratio (CC), identical for both languages. Validation reports the Seen splits used for model selection. Training and validation vary by development set size, while test sets vary by unseen-product ratio.
blocks.zh: 表1: 两种语文的对等比例(CC)。 校验报告用于模型选择的Seen拆分. 培训和验证因开发设置大小而异,而测试装置则因未见产品比例而异。

blocks.en: The benchmark attributes do not contain many missing values as name and price are available in every product offer, whereas brand and description have a density of over 99 % in all variants.
blocks.zh: 基准属性并不包含许多缺失值,因为每个产品报价中都有名称和价格,而品牌和描述在所有变种中密度超过99%。

blocks.en: 2.5 Product Categories
blocks.zh: 2.5 产品类别

blocks.en: The benchmark spans the full product catalog of a general-purpose price comparison portal. To enable category-level analysis, all products were assigned to a unified taxonomy of thirteen top-level categories. 3 3 3 Category vocabulary with German and English labels: https://github.com/wbsg-uni-mannheim/billiger-de-products/blob/main/docs/product-taxonomy.json . The taxonomy provides a common top-level vocabulary across retailer-specific category hierarchies. The retailer-provided category paths (over 190,000 distinct strings) follow no common standard. We map these paths to the fixed categories in two stages: rule-based keyword mapping over normalized category paths, followed by GPT-5-mini classification of the remaining cases into the same taxonomy. A manual validation on a random sample of 500 products found 89.0 % of the assignments correct, 7.4 % ambiguous (products plausibly belonging to two categories, such as protein powder as sports or food), and 3.6 % wrong, with the errors spread across categories.
blocks.zh: 该基准涵盖一个通用价格比较门户的全部产品目录。 为了便于进行分类分析,所有产品都被划入13个顶级类别的统一分类。 3 3 带有德语和英语标签的分类词汇:https://github.com/wbsg-uni-mannheim/billiger-de-products/blob/main/docs/products-taxonomy.json. 分类学提供了跨零售商特定类别等级的常见顶级词汇. 零售商提供的分类路径(超过19万个不同字符串)没有遵循共同的标准. 我们将这些路径映射到固定的分类中,分两个阶段:基于规则的关键字映射到规范的分类路径上,然后将其余案例的GBT-5-mini分类到同一个分类中. 对随机抽查的500种产品进行人工验证,发现89.0%的任务正确,7.4%的模棱两可(产品显然属于两类,如运动或食物等蛋白粉),3.6%的错误,错误分布在不同类别之间.

blocks.en: Table 2: Share of product offers per category in the training and test splits in percent, averaged over all variants.
blocks.zh: 表2:各类产品在培训和测试中所占的份额(百分比),按所有变种平均分列。

blocks.en: Table 2 shows the resulting category distribution. Clothing & Accessories, Furniture & Living, and Electronics & Computers account for the largest shares, which mirrors European e-commerce markets, where fashion is the most frequently purchased category, followed by home-related goods and electronics [ 18 , 32 ] .
blocks.zh: 表2显示由此产生的类别分布情况。 服装和附属品、家具和生活以及电子和计算机占最大份额,这反映了欧洲电子商务市场,当时的时尚是购买最频繁的类别,其次是家庭用品和电子产品[18,32]。

blocks.en: 3 Validation of the Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 审定基准

blocks.en: We evaluate six supervised matchers and zero-shot GPT-5.2 on all 27 variants of both languages to assess benchmark difficulty and provide baselines. XLM-R is evaluated as an additional supervised matcher on the 80 % corner-case variants (Section 4.2 ) and in the cross-language experiment (Section 5 ). We distinguish feature-based matchers, fine-tuned pretrained language model (PLM)-based matchers, and the zero-shot LLM. The PLM-based group comprises RoBERTa, XLM-R, R-SupCon, HierGAT, and Ditto.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了两种语言所有27种变种的6个有监督的匹配者和零镜头的GPT-5.2,以评估基准难度并提供基线。 XLM-R在80%的角箱变体(第4.2节)和跨语言实验(第5节)中被评价为额外监督匹配者。 我们区分基于特征的匹配者,精细的预训语言模型(PLM)基于匹配者,以及零镜头LLM. 以PLM为基础的小组包括RoBERTa、XLM-R、R-SupCon、HierGAT和Ditto。

blocks.en: Precision, recall, and F1 are measured for the match class. Supervised results are mean test F1 over three training seeds per variant. The standard deviation across seeds has a median of 1.3 F1 and stays below 3 F1 for 86 % of the supervised configurations. Larger deviations occur mainly for Ditto and HierGAT on the small development sets. Per-seed results, standard deviations, precision, and recall are available in the repository. Hyperparameters follow the WDC Products codebase 4 4 4 https://github.com/wbsg-uni-mannheim/wdcproducts . The following paragraphs describe each matcher.
blocks.zh: 精度,召回,以及F1为匹配类进行测量. 监督结果为每变种3种训练种子的F1平均测试结果. 不同种子的标准偏差中位数为1.3 F1,在86%的受监督配置中保持在3 F1以下. 较大的偏差主要发生在Ditto和HierGAT小开发集上. 每种子结果,标准偏差,精确度,和召回率都可以在寄存器中找到. 超参数沿着WDC产品代码库4 4 4 https://github.com/wbsg-uni-mannheim/wdcproducts. 以下段落介绍每个匹配者。

blocks.en: WordCooc: A symbolic baseline used in WDC Products [ 26 ] that uses binary word co-occurrence statistics over brand, name, description, and price as features for classical classifiers (Logistic Regression, LinearSVC, Decision Trees, Random Forests, Naive Bayes, XGBoost), with hyperparameters from a randomized search. For each training set, the classifier with the highest validation F1 is reported.
blocks.zh: 词库: WDC Products[26]中使用的象征性基线,将二进制单词在品牌,名称,描述和价格方面的统计作为古典分类器(Logistic Regression, LinearSVC,决策树,随机森林,Naive Bayes,XGBooost)的特征,其超参数来自随机搜索. 每套培训都报告具有最高验证度的分类器F1。

blocks.en: Magellan: Magellan [ 14 ] automatically generates token-, character-, and numeric-similarity features for each attribute based on attribute statistics. Magellan trains the same classifiers as the WordCooc baseline on these features, with hyperparameter optimization on the validation set.
blocks.zh: 麦哲伦:麦哲伦[14]根据属性统计,自动生成每个属性的符号-,字符-和数字-同义特征. 麦哲伦在这些特征上训练与WordCooc基线相同的分类器,在验证集上进行超参数优化.

blocks.en: RoBERTa: A RoBERTa-base cross-encoder [ 17 ] that serializes each product offer pair into a combined input sequence and is fine-tuned end-to-end with a binary classification head and early stopping. RoBERTa is predominantly pre-trained on English data.
blocks.zh: RoBERTA:一个RoBERTa-base的跨编码器[17],将每个产品提供对成组合的输入序列,并用二进制分类头和早期停止来微调端到端. RoBERTA主要接受英语数据预训.

blocks.en: XLM-R: XLM-R [ 8 ] is a RoBERTa variant pre-trained with masked language modeling on monolingual text in 100 languages, including German. It is fine-tuned using the same pipeline as the RoBERTa matcher.
blocks.zh: XLM-R: XLM-R [8]是一个RoBERTa变体,经过预先训练,在包括德语在内的100种语言的单语文字上采用蒙面语言模型. 它使用与RoBERTa火柴相同的管道进行了微调。

blocks.en: R-SupCon: R-SupCon [ 24 ] performs supervised contrastive pre-training of a RoBERTa-base model using the respective benchmark development set so that offers of the same product form clusters in the embedding space. The model is then fine-tuned end-to-end together with a classification head on pairwise offers for the final matching decision.
blocks.zh: R-SupCon:R-SupCon [24] 利用各自的基准开发集,对RoBERTa基模型进行有监督的对比性前培训,以便在嵌入空间中提供相同的产品形式集群。 该模型随后被微调端对端,同时在双向报价上加一个分类头,用于最终匹配决定.

blocks.en: HierGAT: HierGAT [ 36 ] combines transformer text encoding with a hierarchical graph representation of tokens, attributes, and records. It uses contextualized token embeddings to encode individual attributes and compares corresponding attributes across a record pair. Graph attention then weights these attribute comparisons to form a representation of the pair, which a classifier uses to predict whether the records match.
blocks.zh: HierGAT:HierGAT [36] 将变压器文本编码与符号,属性,和记录的分级图示结合. 它使用上下文化的符号嵌入来编码个人属性,并比较一个记录对中的相应属性. 图形注意度然后对这些属性比较进行加权,形成对子的表示,分类者用来预测记录是否匹配.

blocks.en: Ditto: Ditto [ 16 ] is a transformer cross-encoder based on RoBERTa-base and one of the first PLM-based systems for entity matching. Ditto adds data augmentation (token deletion and swapping) and injection of domain knowledge compared to the RoBERTa baseline.
blocks.zh: Ditto:Ditto [16]是一台基于RoBERTa-base的变压器交叉编码器,也是最早的基于PLM的系统之一,用于实体匹配. 与 RoBERTa 基线相比, Ditto 添加了数据增强(token 删除和互换)和域知识的注入.

blocks.en:
GPT-5.2 (zero-shot): Following the protocol of Peeters et al. [ 27 ] ,
GPT-5.2 (snapshot gpt-5.2-2025-12-11 ) is queried zero-shot (without using the training sets) for every test pair using the OpenAI Batch API in July 2026. Two different prompts are compared, which are shown in Figure 3 . The Simple prompt asks whether two product descriptions refer to the same real-world product and requests a Yes/No answer. The Rule-Guided prompt additionally encodes the identity definition of the benchmark: variants differing in size, color, configuration, capacity, or package quantity are not matches, conflicts in identifying attributes must yield “No”, missing attributes alone are not a conflict, and a match requires positive evidence of equivalence. Both prompts serialize brand, name, description, and price and were adapted to the benchmark language. Requests use API defaults for reasoning effort and sampling parameters. Answers are normalized to binary decisions using the requested language or 1/0. We restrict the evaluation to a single LLM, as covering all combinations of test set, language, and prompt already requires roughly 160,000 classification requests per model.
blocks.zh:
GPT-5.2(零射):按照Peeters等人的协议[27],
GPT-5.2(snapshot gpt-5.2-2025-12-11)于2026年7月使用OpenAI Batch API对每对测试对进行零射(不使用训练集)询问. 比较了两个不同的提示,如图3所示。 简单提示询问两个产品描述是否指同一个现实世界产品,并要求有/没有答案. "规则指引"的提示还另外编码了基准的特性定义:大小、颜色、配置、容量或包数量不同的变体不匹配,识别属性方面的冲突必须产生“否”,缺失属性本身并不是冲突,匹配需要等同性的积极证据。 两者都促使品牌、名称、描述和价格的序列化,并适应基准语言。 请求使用API默认进行推理努力和采样参数. 使用所要求的语言或1/0. 将答复正常化为二进制决定。 我们把评价限制在一个单一的LLM上,因为涵盖测试集的所有组合,语言,以及迅速已经要求每个模型大约16万个分类请求.

blocks.en: Figure 3: The two zero-shot prompts for GPT-5.2 in their English form, with the serialized records appended for i ∈ { 1 , 2 } i\in\{1,2\} . The German versions are on the benchmark website.
blocks.zh: 图3:GPT-5.2的两个0射速提示的英文格式,其序列式记录附在i {{1,2}i\in {1,2}的上. 德语版本在基准网站上.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果

blocks.en: Section 4.1 reports performance along the three benchmark dimensions, Section 4.2 compares languages, and Section 4.3 compares product categories. Section 4.4 relates the results to WDC Products and Abt-Buy.
blocks.zh: 第4.1节按三个基准维度报告业绩,第4.2节比较语文,第4.3节比较产品类别。 第4.4节将结果与WDC产品和Abt-Buy有关。

blocks.en: 4.1 Results Along the Benchmark Dimensions
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准层面的成果

blocks.en: Table 3 reports F1 for the six supervised matchers and both GPT-5.2 prompts across the 27 German variants, and Table 4 the difference to the English version per variant.
blocks.zh: 表3 报告 6名受监督的配对选手的F1和GPT-5.2都横跨27个德国变种,表4为每个变种与英文版本的区别.

blocks.en:
The results underline the difficulty of the benchmark. The feature-based approaches WordCooc and Magellan average 43.01 and 42.45 F1 across the 27 German variants, which is too low to be of practical use (Table 3 ). Neural matchers such as Ditto reach up to 86.39 F1 in seen configurations but remain strongly affected by unseen entities. Averaged across all corner-case ratios and development set sizes, Ditto loses 21.57 F1 from the Seen to the Unseen test sets (Table 3 ).
Zero-shot GPT-5.2 is also not able to solve the benchmark, as its scores under the stronger Rule-Guided prompt remain between 77.78 and 84.91 F1 (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh:
结果突出了基准的困难。 基于特征的方法WordCooc和Magellan平均为43.01和42.45 F1,分布于27个德国变体,太低,无法实际使用(表3). Ditto等神经匹配器在可见配置中可达86.39 F1,但仍受到看不见实体的强烈影响. Ditto从Seen到Unseen测试机组平均损失21.57 F1(表3)。
0射出的GPT-5.2也无法解决基准问题,因为它在更强的"规则指引"(Rules-Guided poil)下的分数仍然在77.78到84.91 F1之间(表3).

blocks.en: The matching systems show clear differences across the three dimensions of the benchmark. F1 decreases as the corner-case ratio grows from 20 % to 80 %, for Ditto for example from 86.39 to 72.18 F1 in the large+seen setting (Table 3 ). F1 further decreases from the Seen to the Unseen test sets, with drops of 35.68, 29.31, and 26.79 F1 for R-SupCon, Ditto, and RoBERTa in the large+20 % corner-case setting, against 26.59, 9.60, and 9.16 F1 reported for WDC Products. The broader product coverage may contribute to these drops. F1 generally increases with the development set size, with individual medium-to-large results deviating from this trend, consistent with PLM-based matchers profiting from more training examples [ 26 ] . Comparing the easiest configuration (large, 20 % corner cases, Seen) with the hardest (small, 80 % corner cases, Unseen), the losses range from 22.94 F1 for Magellan to 57.30 F1 for HierGAT.
blocks.zh: 匹配系统显示出基准三个层面的明显差异。 F1随着转角-病例比率从20%增长到80%,例如,Ditto在大增景区中从86.39降至72.18 F1(表3)。 F1从Seen到Unseen测试机组进一步减少,R-SupCon、Ditto和RoBERTa的降幅分别为35.68、29.31和26.79,而WDC产品为26.59、9.60和9.16 F1。 产品覆盖面的扩大可能促成这些下降。 F1一般随着开发设置的大小而增加,个别的中到大结果偏离了这一趋势,符合基于PLM的配对者从更多的培训实例中获利[26]. 比较最简单的配置(大,20%角箱,Seen)和最困难(小,80%角箱,Unseen),损失范围从麦哲伦的22.94 F1到HierGAT的57.30 F1.

blocks.en: Table 3: F1 on the German version per corner-case ratio (CC), development set size, and test set. Bold: best, underline: second best per variant. Zero-shot GPT-5.2 is independent of the development set size.
blocks.zh: 表3:德国版每角箱比(CC),开发设置大小,测试设置的F1. 粗体:最好,下划线:每个变体第二好. 0镜头的GPT-5.2独立于开发设定大小.

blocks.en: Ditto and HierGAT are the strongest supervised systems across most German variants, reaching 86.39 and 84.10 F1 on the easiest variant. The small-data variants at high corner-case ratios separate the PLM-based models most clearly: on the German Seen test sets with the small development set at 50 % and 80 % corner cases, Ditto, RoBERTa, and R-SupCon stay between 47.91 and 58.31 F1, while HierGAT falls to 33.23 and 24.32 F1 (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: Ditto和HierGAT是大多数德国变种中最强的受监督系统,在最简单的变种上达到86.39和84.10 F1. 高角病例比率的小数据变体将基于PLM的模型最明确地分开:在德国Seen测试集中,小发展设定为50%和80%的角病例,Ditto,RoBERTa和R-SupCon停留在47.91和58.31 F1之间,而HierGAT下降为33.23和24.32 F1(表3)。

blocks.en:
GPT-5.2 varies less across the benchmark dimensions compared to the supervised systems: its F1 spans 19.15 points across the German variants under the Simple prompt and 7.13 points under the Rule-Guided prompt, against 23.13 to 59.78 points for the supervised models (Table 3 ). Part of this stability follows from the design, as the development set size and unseen dimension do not affect a zero-shot model, which relies only on its general purpose training, in the same way as the matchers trained on the benchmark. With the fixed Rule-Guided prompt, GPT-5.2 reaches the highest F1 in 24 of 27 German variants (Table 3 ). The Simple prompt leads on the small and medium Seen variants at 20 % corner cases, and Ditto leads on the large Seen variant. A caveat applies to interpreting the results for the GPT-5 model: the underlying offers were publicly available online and may have appeared in its pre-training data. The pairs, splits, and labels, however, were created specifically for this benchmark and were not available online before its release.
Averaged over the nine German test sets, GPT-5.2 reaches 75.96 F1 with the Simple and 81.29 with the Rule-Guided prompt.
blocks.zh:
与受监管系统相比,GPT-5.2在基准维度上的差异较小:其F1在简易快报下跨德国变种的19.15分,在规则-指导快报下跨7.13分,而受监管模型的23.13至59.78分(表3)。 这种稳定性部分源于设计,因为开发设定的大小和无形的维度并不影响零镜头模型,而零镜头模型仅依赖其通用训练,其方式与在基准上训练的匹配者相同. 在固定的Rule-Guided 迅速下,GPT-5.2在27个德国变体中的24个达到最高的F1(表3). "简单提示"在20%的转角病例中领先中小变种,Ditto则领先大变种. 解释GPT-5模式的结果需要注意:基本报价在网上公开,可能出现在培训前数据中。 然而,这些配对、拆分和标签是专门为这一基准制定的,在发布之前没有在网上提供。
平均在9套德国测试中,GPT-5.2与简易测试达到75.96 F1,规则引导的快速达到81.29.

blocks.en: 4.2 Results on the English Version
blocks.zh: 4.2 英文版本的结果

blocks.en: Table 4: F1 difference between the English and the German version (EN − - DE) per variant, positive values favour English. Adding a cell to Table 3 gives the English F1. Summary rows: mean by development set size, overall mean (bold) and median, and count of variants favouring English.
blocks.zh: 表4:F1按变体排列的英文版和德文版(EN−-DE)的差别,正值偏好英文. 在表3中添加一个单元格给英文F1。 摘要行:按开发设置大小表示,整体平均(粗体)和中位数,计数偏好英语的变体.

blocks.en: This section presents the effect of the offer language on matching performance. For this experiment, supervised models were trained and evaluated on the English variant of the benchmark and then compared to the German results. Table 4 reports the per-variant F1 differences between the English and the German version for all evaluated systems. WordCooc and Magellan remain below 46 mean F1 in both languages, which is too low for practical matching applications, and their small mean language differences do not alter that conclusion. Averaged across all variants, every PLM-based matcher scores higher on the English version, which is likely due to their predominantly English pre-training data. The LLM GPT-5.2 is nearly indifferent to the language (Table 4 ). Language sensitivity is larger when little training data is available: across the six supervised matchers, the mean absolute language gap decreases from 5.63 F1 with the small development sets to 2.86 with the medium and 2.29 with the large sets.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍要约语言对匹配性能的影响. 在这次实验中,对受监督的模型进行了关于基准的英语变体的培训和评价,然后与德国结果进行比较。 表4报告所有评价系统的英文版和德文版的每变种F1差异。 WordCooc和Magellan在两种语言中都保持在46平均F1以下,对于实际匹配的应用来说,这个比例太低,他们小的平均语言差异并不能改变这个结论. 在所有变种中平均,每个基于PLM的配对者在英语版上的得分都较高,这很可能是因为他们以英语为主的预训数据. LLM GPT-5.2对语言几乎漠不关心(表4). 在培训数据很少的情况下,语言敏感性更大:在6名受监督的匹配者中,平均绝对语言差距从5.63 F1小开发套减少到2.86小开发套和2.29大开发套。

blocks.en: WordCooc shows a slight advantage on English in the Seen test sets, although the differences are too small to support a clear conclusion, whereas on the Unseen test sets the advantage is more visible, reaching 6.75 F1 points (large, 20 % corner cases, Table 4 ). A possible explanation is that German compounds reduce exact token overlap between matching records [ 38 ] . Magellan instead slightly favours German (mean − 1.57 -1.57 F1).
blocks.zh: WordCooc在Seen测试集中表现出对英语的微弱优势,尽管差异太小,无法支持一个明确的结论,而在Unseen测试中设置的优势更明显,达到6.75 F1分(大,20%的角病例,表4 ). 一个可能的解释是,德国的化合物减少了匹配记录之间的精确符号重叠[38]. 麦哲伦转而略偏好德语(意为−1.57-1.57 F1).

blocks.en: RoBERTa favours English with a mean difference of + 3.97 +3.97 F1, consistent with its predominantly English pre-training corpus [ 17 ] . The advantage is largest with small development sets and shrinks as more training data becomes available. Fine-tuning therefore allows the English-pretrained model to adapt to German product data. HierGAT shows the largest mean English advantage ( + 7.74 +7.74 F1), while Ditto and R-SupCon are close to parity, although all three fine-tune the same RoBERTa backbone (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh: RoBERTA偏好英语,平均差为+3.97+3.97. F1,与其以英语为主的预训教材一致 [17]. 由于有了更多的培训数据,小型开发组的优势最大,而且收缩。 因此,微调可以让英语预训模型适应德国的产品数据. HierGAT显示最大的平均英语优势(+7.74+7.74 F1),而Ditto和R-SupCon则接近对等,尽管所有三个都对相同的RoBERTa主干线进行了微调(表4).

blocks.en: Table 5 compares the multi-lingual XLM-R with RoBERTa on the 80 % corner-case variants. On German, XLM-R scores above RoBERTa in all nine cells, by 1.8 to 10.0 F1, with the largest gains on the small development sets. On English the two stay within 3.8 F1 of each other, with RoBERTa ahead on the large sets. The average language difference is small with the multilingual backbone: over the nine cells, XLM-R scores 0.55 F1 higher on English than on German, RoBERTa 5.82 F1. This indicates that the English advantage of RoBERTa stems mainly from its backbone rather than from differences between the German and the translated English data, since the same pipeline on the same pairs shows almost no such advantage with the multilingual encoder. For matching in a non-English market, a multilingual encoder is the better starting point: it gains 1.8 to 10.0 F1 on German at a cost of at most 3.3 F1 on the large English sets.
blocks.zh: 表5在80%的角箱变体上将多种语言的XLM-R与RoBERTa进行比较. 在德语上,XLM-R在所有9个细胞中都得分高于RoBERTa,以1.8比10.0的F1,在小开发集上收获最大. 在英语上,两者在 3.8 F1 以内,在大套机上,罗贝塔领先。 与多语言骨干相比,平均语言差异较小:在9个细胞上,XLM-R在英语上的得分比德语的RoBERTa 5.82 F1. 这说明RoBERTa的英语优势主要源于它的骨干,而不是德语数据与翻译的英语数据之间的差异,因为同一对子上的同一管道在多语种编码器上几乎没有显示出这样的优势. 对于非英语市场的匹配,多语种编码器是较好的起点:它在德语上以最多3.3 F1的价格在大型英语套装上以1.8到10.0 F1的比价得到增益.

blocks.en: Table 5: F1 of RoBERTa and XLM-R on the 80 % corner-case variants of both language versions, mean over three seeds.
blocks.zh: 表5:RoBERTa和XLM-R两种语言版本的80%角箱变种上的F1,意为3个以上种子.

blocks.en: Table 6: Mean same-category F1 on German over nine test sets, seeds, and development sizes. Bold: best per category. Train/Test count record occurrences in pairs of the large 80 % corner-case training/Half-Seen test sets. Pet Supplies is absent. Food & Beverages and Books, Films & Music have fewer than 50 test records.
blocks.zh: 表6:德国9个测试组、种子和开发规模的同一类别F1平均值。 粗体:每个类别最好。 火车/ 测试计数记录在80%的大角箱训练/半目测试集的对子中出现. 宠物用品不在 Food & Beverages and Books, Films & Music的测试记录不到50张.

blocks.en: The largest individual difference for GPT-5.2, 3.34 F1 under the Rule-Guided prompt, stems from single runs per variant, and Section 5 reports an observed run-to-run spread of 1.74 F1 for repeated DE-DE requests. A small language effect under the Rule-Guided prompt therefore remains plausible, possibly because explicit rule application profits from the stronger representation of English in LLM pre-training corpora [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh: GPT-5.2、3.34 F1在规则指导的提示下的最大个人差异来自每个变体的单次运行,第5节报告,重复的DE-DE请求的运行分布为1.74 F1。 因此,在《规则指南》的提示下,一个小的语言效果仍然是可行的,可能是因为明确的规则应用得益于在LLM预训公司中更有力地代表英语[29]。

blocks.en: 4.3 Results Across Product Categories
blocks.zh: 4.3 各产品类别的成果

blocks.en: This section compares matching difficulty across the thirteen product categories. For each model, every test pair is annotated with the categories of its two products and F1 is computed per category pair. Table 6 reports the same-category F1, averaged over all nine German test sets, together with the number of records per category in the pairs of the 80 % corner-case large training set and the corresponding Half-Seen test set. Rows are ordered by the number of training records.
blocks.zh: 本节比较13个产品类别的匹配困难。 对于每个型号,每对试验配对都附有其两种产品的类别说明,F1则按类别配对计算. 表6报告的是同一类F1,所有9套德国测试集的平均值,以及80%角箱大型培训集的对数和相应的半视测试集的每类记录数量. 排行顺序为训练记录的数量.

blocks.en: The category ranking is stable across the model families. Among the nine largest categories, Clothing & Accessories and Furniture & Living are the two hardest for every model except WordCooc, for which Automotive & Motorcycle replaces Clothing. Within these nine categories, Clothing is the single hardest for seven of the eight model columns. One possible explanation is that similar product variants, generally less structured attributes, and vendor-specific naming of colors, materials, and styles make identity harder to distinguish from textual similarity. Electronics & Computers and Health & Care rank among the three easiest categories for seven of the eight model columns each, while Tools & DIY and Toys & Baby are in the upper half for every model. Model numbers, manufacturer identifiers, and standardized technical specifications may provide more distinctive matching signals in these categories.
blocks.zh: 跨模范家庭的类别排名稳定. 在9个最大的类别中,服装和附属品以及家具和生活是每个型号中最难的两个,只有WordCooc除外,汽车和摩托车取代服装。 在这9个类别中,服装是8个型号列中7个最难的单件. 一种可能的解释是,类似的产品变体,一般结构性较弱的属性,以及针对供应商的颜色,材料和样式命名,使得身份与文字相似性难以区分. 电子与计算机以及健康与护理在8个模型栏中的7个最简单类别中排名第3位,而工具与DIY和玩具与宝贝则在每个模型的上半部. 模型编号、制造商识别标志和标准化技术规格可能在这些类别中提供更独特的匹配信号。

blocks.en: The category matching performance ranking differs from the ranking by training-record counts. The three largest categories contain the two hardest categories as well as one of the easiest, and Health & Care, with 1,006 training records against more than 8,700 in each of the three largest categories, scores above Clothing and Furniture for every model and above Electronics for five of the eight model columns (Table 6 ). The lower scores for clothing and furniture show the value of evaluating matchers beyond electronics. Repeating the category analysis on the English benchmark version for WordCooc, Magellan, RoBERTa, R-SupCon, and GPT-5.2 yields the same picture: the ranking of the categories stays largely unchanged, and the per-category shifts are of the same order as each matcher’s overall language difference (Section 4.2 ). The corresponding English category scores are available on the benchmark website. 5 5 5 https://wbsg-uni-mannheim.github.io/billiger-de-products/#results
blocks.zh: 类别匹配的性能排名通过培训记录计数与排名不同. 三个最大的类别包括两个最难的类别以及一个最容易的类别,即保健和护理,三个最大的类别中每个类别有1 006个培训记录,而八个模式栏中,每个模式栏中五个模式栏的成绩都高于服装和家具(表6)。 服装和家具的分数较低,表明评价电子产品以外的配对者的价值。 重复WordCooc、Magellan、RoBERTa、R-SupCon和GPT-5.2的英文基准版本的类别分析得出相同情况:类别排名基本保持不变,每个类别的班次与每个匹配者的总体语言差异顺序相同(第4.2节)。 基准网站上有相应的英文类分数。 5 5 5 5 https://wbsg-uni-mannheim.github.io/billiger-de-products/#results

blocks.en: 4.4 Comparison with WDC Products and Abt-Buy
blocks.zh: 4.4 与WDC产品和Abt-Buy的比较

blocks.en: This section compares the English results with the published results of the same matchers on WDC Products [ 26 , Table 3] and Abt-Buy [ 24 , Table 3] . Averaged over the 27 configurations that Billiger.de Products shares with WDC Products, RoBERTa, Ditto, HierGAT, and R-SupCon score 8.8 to 19.0 F1 lower on the English version of Billiger.de Products (Tables 3 and 4 ). WordCooc and Magellan score 0.2 and 5.4 F1 higher, so the gap is specific to the PLM-based matchers, while the ranking of the six matchers is the same on both benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 本节将英文结果与WDC产品[26,表3]和Abt-Buy[24,表3]上同一配对者的公布结果进行比较。 Billiger.de产品与WDC产品、RoBERTA、Ditto、HierGAT和R-SupCON共用的27种配置平均比Billiger.de产品在英文版Billiger.de产品(表3和表4)的比分低8.8比19.0 F1。 WordCooc和麦哲伦的得分较高,分别为0.2分和5.4分F1分,因此差距是PLM制的选手所特有的,而六个选手的排名在两个基准上都是相同的.

blocks.en: Abt-Buy has no difficulty variants. Even on the easiest English configuration (20 % corner cases, large, Seen), RoBERTa, Ditto, and R-SupCon score 1.0 to 9.7 F1 below their published Abt-Buy results. Averaged across all 27 variants of Billiger.de Products, their scores are 27.4 to 42.5 F1 lower. The published results were obtained with the training protocols of their papers, so the comparison is descriptive. A possible explanation for the gap is the category mix, as electronics dominate WDC Products and Abt-Buy and are among the easier categories in Section 4.3 . These comparisons show lower F1 for the PLM-based matchers on the English version of Billiger.de Products than on the two established benchmarks.
blocks.zh: Abt-Buy没有困难的变体. 即使在最简单的英语配置(20 % 角大小,Seen),RoBERTA,Ditto,以及R-SupCon的比分比他们公布的Abt-Buy成绩低1.0比9.7 F1. Billiger.de Products的所有27种变种的平均分数,其分数为27.4比42.5 F1低. 公布的结果是用他们论文的训练规程取得的,因此比较是描述性的. 差距的一个可能解释是类别组合,因为电子在WDC产品和Abt-Buy中占主导地位,属于第4.3节中比较容易的类别。 这些比较显示,在英语版Billiger上,基于PLM的匹配者F1较低. d 产品高于两项既定基准。

blocks.en: 5 Cross-Language Matching
blocks.zh: 5 跨语言匹配

blocks.en: This section evaluates German-trained matchers on pairs whose records are written in different languages, simulating a German price comparison portal expanding to English-language markets. Section 4.2 evaluated the two languages separately.
blocks.zh: 本节评价德国训练的配对选手,他们的记录用不同的语言书写,模拟了一个德国价格比较门户,扩展到英语市场. 第4.2节分别评价了这两种语文。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: All supervised matchers are trained and selected using the training and validation splits, respectively, of the German 80 % corner-case large development set. Each selected model is then evaluated, without further training, on five variants of the German 80 % corner-case Half-Seen test set (4,427 pairs each). In DE-DE both records are the German originals, which is the default same-language matching task. In DE-EN and EN-DE the left or the right record is replaced by its English translation. EN-EN represents the case of generalizing a German-trained matcher to fully English pairs. Mixed combines the four language combinations in equal shares.
blocks.zh: 所有受监督的匹配者都分别通过德国80%的角箱大型开发集的培训和验证分拆来进行培训和挑选. 然后,在未经进一步培训的情况下,对德国80%的角箱半视试验集(每套4,427对)的五个变体进行评估。 在DE-DE中,两种记录都是德文原件,这是默认的同文匹配任务. 在DE-EN和EN-DE中,左或右记录被其英文翻译所取代. EN-EN代表了将德国训练的配对者概括为完全英语配对的情况. 混合将四种语言组合在平等份额中结合.

blocks.en: GPT-5.2 receives the German prompt in all five variants, and its zero-shot requests were repeated three times per prompt and variant. The supervised matchers report the mean over three seeds from training runs conducted independently of the main evaluation. For the supervised matchers, the small differences between the DE-DE scores in Tables 3 and 7 reflect these independent runs, which use the same training and validation splits. Within this experiment, language effects are measured relative to each model’s own DE-DE baseline.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.2在所有五个变体中都接收了德国的速报,其零发请求被每速报和变体重复三次. 受监督的配对者报告说,培训的种子平均超过3个,独立于主要评价。 对于受监督的匹配者,表3和表7中DE-DE分数之间的小差异反映了这些独立运行,它们使用相同的训练和验证分数. 在这个实验中,语言效应是相对于每个模型自己的DE-DE基线来衡量的.

blocks.en: 5.2 Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果

blocks.en: Table 7: F1 on the five language variants of the 80 % corner-case Half-Seen test set and difference to DE-DE, computed from unrounded means. Supervised matchers are trained on German pairs only and report means over seeds, GPT-5.2 means over three repetitions.
blocks.zh: 表 7: 80% 角箱的5种语言变体的F1 半视差测试集与DE-DE的差值,用未四舍五入的方法计算. 监督的选手只接受德国对子的训练,报告的意思是超过种子,GPT-5.2的意思是超过三次重复.

blocks.en: RoBERTa, XLM-R, HierGAT, and Ditto lose 6.0 to 10.9 F1 on DE-EN and EN-DE, compared with 0.3 to 4.8 on fully English pairs (Table 7 ). The separate-language evaluation (Section 4.2 ) shows that the models can match both German and English offers. Cross-language pairs may disrupt shared lexical cues learned from German pairs when only one record is translated. XLM-R loses 6.0 and 6.9 F1 on DE-EN and EN-DE but only 0.3 F1 on EN-EN, so multilingual pre-training alone does not prevent the cross-language loss in this setting. R-SupCon is the exception: it stays within 1.0 F1 of DE-DE on cross-language pairs and loses most on EN-EN (6.0 F1). Its cross-language F1 remains below XLM-R and Ditto, so the smaller loss does not imply stronger absolute performance.
blocks.zh: RoBERTa,XLM-R,HierGAT,以及Ditto在DE-EN和EN-DE上损失了6.0到10.9 F1,而在完全英语对上则损失了0.3到4.8(表7). 单独语言的评价(第4.2节)表明,这些模型既可以匹配德语和英语的报价。 当只翻译了一张唱片时,跨语言对子可能会干扰从德国对子学来的共享词汇提示. XLM-R在DE-EN和EN-DE上损失6.0和6.9 F1,但在EN-EN上仅损失0.3 F1,因此仅多语种预训并不能防止在此情况下的跨语种损失. R-SupCon是例外:它停留在DE-DE的1.0 F1跨语言对上,在EN-EN(6.0 F1)上损失最多. 其跨语言的F1仍然位于XLM-R和Ditto以下,因此较小的损失并不意味着绝对性能更强.

blocks.en: WordCooc loses most on EN-EN (15.4 F1), because its co-occurrence features require a token to appear in both records, and shared English tokens may lie outside the feature space fitted on German training pairs. Magellan stays within 2.4 F1 of DE-DE across variants, consistent with its similarity features being less affected by language (Table 7 ).
blocks.zh: WordCooc在EN-EN(15.4 F1)上输得最多,因为其共性特性需要在两个记录中都出现一个符号,共享的英语符号可能位于德国训练对上安装的特征空间之外. 麦哲伦在各种变体的DE-DE中停留在2.4 F1范围内,这与其受语言影响较小的相似性相一致(表7)。

blocks.en: GPT-5.2 reaches the highest F1 in every variant and shows no consistent cross-language penalty. With the Rule-Guided prompt, the spread across variants (1.42 F1) is smaller than the spread across three repetitions of identical DE-DE requests (1.74 F1). The Simple prompt’s between-variant spread of 2.92 F1, compared with a repetition spread of 1.10 F1, suggests a small language effect. These comparisons describe the observed spread rather than establish statistical significance.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.2在每个变体中达到最高的F1,没有显示一致的跨语罚. 在规则指引的提示下,不同变体的分布(1.42 F1)比相同DE-DE请求的三次重复的分布(1.74 F1)要小. Simple protes的变种分布为2.92 F1,而重复分布为1.10 F1,这表明语言效果很小. 这些比较说明观察到的分布,而不是确定统计意义。

blocks.en: The EN-EN results support earlier observations of transfer between languages [ 23 , 1 ] . The cross-language test sets additionally expose a transfer difficulty for four of the five PLM-based matchers under German-only training.
blocks.zh: EN-EN结果支持早先对语言间转录的观察[23, 1]. 跨语言测试还额外暴露了5名基于PLM的选手中4名在德国唯一训练下的转会困难.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Entity matching has been researched since the 1940s [ 10 , 12 ] . Early systems compared records using string similarity metrics [ 7 ] . Supervised systems such as Magellan generate similarity features across record attributes and train classifiers on them [ 14 ] . Christophides et al. [ 6 ] give an overview of the resolution workflows of this period. Deep learning architectures learn record representations end-to-end [ 21 ] and are surveyed in [ 3 , 13 ] . PLM-based systems include cross-encoders such as Ditto [ 16 ] , supervised contrastive learning in R-SupCon [ 24 ] , and hierarchical graph attention in HierGAT [ 36 ] . Section 3 describes these systems. Recently, large language models have been applied to entity matching in zero-shot settings [ 22 , 25 , 27 , 37 ] as well as via fine-tuning [ 31 ] . Wang et al. [ 34 ] compare pairwise matching with comparing and selecting candidate records, finding selection the most cost-effective strategy in their experiments. These studies show that LLMs reach performance comparable to task-specific matchers without labelled training data. Almost all of them were conducted on English benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 从1940年代开始对实体匹配进行研究[10,12]. 早期系统使用字符串相似度度量法比较记录 [7]. 麦哲伦等监督系统在记录属性之间产生相似性特征,并在它们上产生列车分类器[14]. 克里斯托菲德斯等人著. [6] 概述这一时期的解决工作流程。 深层学习架构学习记录表达[21],在[3,13]中调查. 基于PLM的系统包括跨编码器,如Ditto [16],在R-SupCon [24] 中监督对比性学习,在HierGAT [36] 中分级图注意. 第3节描述了这些系统。 最近,大型语言模型被应用于零镜头设置中的实体匹配[22,25,27,37]以及通过微调[31]. 王等编. [34] 比较对等匹配与比较和选择候选记录,发现选择是其实验中最具成本效益的战略. 这些研究表明,LLMS的性能与特定任务匹配者相比,没有标注培训数据. 它们几乎都是按照英语基准进行的。

blocks.en: A broad range of benchmarks supports the evaluation of matching systems. The tasks compiled by Köpcke et al. [ 15 ] , such as Abt-Buy and Amazon-Google, and the Magellan datasets [ 14 ] , such as Walmart-Amazon, are widely used and were profiled in detail by Primpeli and Bizer [ 28 ] . The Alaska benchmark covers multi-source integration tasks for cameras and monitors [ 9 ] , and Machamp compiles matching tasks over pairs of differing structuredness [ 33 ] . All of these benchmarks contain English records and provide a single level of task difficulty per dataset. Ember, a Chinese-language product matching benchmark, additionally evaluates generalization to unseen entities [ 35 ] . Możdżonek et al. [ 20 ] release the first open Polish product matching dataset, built from drugstore and beverage offers in three training set sizes, and ProMapCz provides Czech product pairs with graded close and medium non-matches [ 19 ] . Alves [ 2 ] describes two Portuguese corpora: eCommerce contains product titles from Brazilian marketplaces, and Notas Fiscais contains short invoice descriptions of dairy products, cosmetics, and vehicle suspension parts. Both provide random and hard-negative pair variants. Table 8 reports their hard-negative variants, summing the three categories for Notas Fiscais [ 2 , Table 6.3] . The Markt-Pilot dataset provides a large collection of web-scraped offer pairs for industrial products such as automation and machine components in German and English [ 30 ] . WDC Products [ 26 ] added the multi-dimensional design with controlled corner-case ratios, unseen-entity ratios, and three development set sizes, built from English schema.org data dominated by consumer electronics. Table 8 compares the discussed benchmarks along language, domain, size, and difficulty dimensions. Our benchmark adopts the design of WDC Products and adds German-language consumer product data, a thirteen-category product mix, a parallel English translation, and cross-language test sets. The PLM-based matchers evaluated in Section 4 score 9 to 19 F1 lower on the English version of Billiger.de Products than on WDC Products. Even on the easiest English configuration, RoBERTa, Ditto, and R-SupCon score below their published Abt-Buy results, positioning Billiger.de Products as a challenging benchmark for English-language product matching (Section 4.4 ).

Markt-Pilot数据集为自动化和机器组件等工业产品提供了大量网络拼接的报价配对,使用德语和英语[30]. WDC产品 [26] 添加了多维设计,带有可控角箱比,无形实体比,以及基于以消费电子为主的英语schema.org数据构建的三个开发集尺寸. 表8按语言、域、大小和难度层面比较了所讨论的基准。 我们的基准采用WDC产品的设计,并增加德语消费产品数据、13类产品组合、平行的英文翻译和跨语言测试集。 第4节评价的基于PLM的匹配者在英语版Billiger上得分9比19 F1更低. d 产品比WDC产品。 即使在最简单的英语配置上,RoBERTA,Ditto,以及R-SupCon的得分也低于他们公布的Abt-Buy结果,定位Billiger. de 产品是英语产品匹配的一个挑战性基准(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: A recent survey of deep learning for entity resolution names cross-language matching among the open research directions [ 13 ] . Peeters and Bizer [ 23 ] observed that a multilingual transformer trained on English pairs can transfer matching performance to other languages. Alves et al. [ 1 ] train product matchers on English data for use on Portuguese data and report promising results with little training data in the target language. In both studies, the language of a record is a property of its data source rather than a controlled condition. Billiger.de Products provides the same pairs in German, English, and two cross-language versions. Combined with its controlled corner-case ratios, unseen-entity ratios, and development set sizes, this supports studying language effects alongside all three difficulty dimensions.
blocks.zh: 最近对实体解析深度学习的调查显示,在开放研究方向之间进行了跨语言匹配[13]。 Peeters and Bizer [23]观察到,一个受过英语对子训练的多语种变速器可以将匹配性能转移到其他语言. 阿尔维斯等人. [1] 对产品配对者进行英语数据培训,供葡萄牙数据使用,并报告有希望的结果,很少使用目标语言的培训数据。 在这两项研究中,记录的语言是其数据来源的属性,而不是一个可控条件. 比利格尔.de 产品提供德语,英语和两个跨语言版本的同对版本. 结合其控制角-病例比率、无形-实体比率以及开发设定的大小,这支持对所有三个难度层面同时研究语言效应。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduced Billiger.de Products, an entity matching benchmark built from offers of the German price comparison platform billiger.de. It covers thirteen product categories, provides fixed splits along the dimensions corner-case ratio, fraction of unseen products, and development set size following the design of WDC Products, and includes an aligned English translation of every offer that keeps all pairs, splits, and labels fixed.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍 Billiger.de 产品,根据德国价格比较平台billiger.de的报价构建的实体匹配基准. 它涵盖13个产品类别,按照维度角-箱比提供固定的分割,未见产品的分数,以及WDC产品设计后的开发设定大小,并包括每一份报价的对齐英文译文,保持所有对,分,标签的固定.

blocks.en: The evaluation of six supervised matchers and zero-shot GPT-5.2 on all 27 variants of both language versions shows that the benchmark is difficult: no supervised matcher exceeds 55 F1 in the 80 % corner-case Unseen variants. On the English version, the PLM-based matchers score 9 to 19 F1 below their published results on WDC Products. Even on the easiest English configuration, RoBERTa, Ditto, and R-SupCon score below their published Abt-Buy results, positioning Billiger.de Products as a challenging benchmark for English-language product matching. Clothing and furniture are the hardest categories for nearly every matcher and electronics among the easiest, which shows the value of evaluating matchers beyond electronics.
blocks.zh: 对两种语言版本所有27种变体的6个有监督的配对者和零镜头的GPT-5.2的评价表明,该基准很困难:在80%的角箱Unseen变体中,没有监督的配对者超过55个F1. 在英文版上,基于PLM的匹配者在WDC产品上其公布的结果低于9比19的F1得分. 即使在最简单的英语配置上,RoBERTA,Ditto,以及R-SupCon的得分也低于他们公布的Abt-Buy结果,定位Billiger. de 产品是英语产品匹配的一个挑战性基准。 服装和家具是几乎所有火柴和电子产品中最简单的一类,这表明评价电子产品以外的火柴的价值。

blocks.en:
Averaged across variants, the PLM-based matchers score higher when trained and evaluated in English than in German, with the largest gains for RoBERTa and HierGAT. Under German-only training, RoBERTa, XLM-R, HierGAT, and Ditto lose 6 to 11 F1 on cross-language pairs, whereas R-SupCon stays close to its German score and GPT-5.2 shows no consistent cross-language penalty.
Future work can build on the benchmark in several directions. The cross-language test sets enable a systematic comparison of translate-then-match pipelines with multilingual matchers and LLMs.
Extending the evaluation to additional languages and models would test how far the stability observed for GPT-5.2 carries beyond German and English.
blocks.zh:
平均跨变种,基于PLM的配对者在英语培训和评价时得分高于德语,对RoBERTa和HierGAT的收益最大. 在仅接受德语训练的情况下,RoBERTa,XLM-R,HierGAT,和Ditto在跨语言对决中以6比11的比分输掉F1,而R-SupCon则保持接近其德语分数,GPT-5.2显示没有一致的跨语言罚.
今后的工作可以在若干方面以基准为基础。 跨语言测试集能够系统比较当时的翻译和匹配管道与多语言匹配器和LLMs.
将评价范围扩大到其他语言和模型,将检验所观察到的GPT-5.2的稳定性在多大程度上超出德语和英语。
